extras: This is a community plugin and is not affiliated with Obsidian or omg.lol.
intentEvidence: Omg.publish is a plugin for Obsidian that allows you post notes to omg.lol services like statuslog or weblog (planned).
problem: Users need a simple way to share selected text from their Obsidian notes to external services like statuslog.
summary: Omg.publish allows users to post selected text from Obsidian notes to external services like OMG.lol statuslog.
